title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.17: Book of Order now injects BOTH flank bosses (far-left + far-right) with a seeded left/right encounter assignment, so all three of the act's bosses are reachable and you route to the ending you choose. Deterministic across load/co-op.
